description: Electricity Generation in TWh is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). This dataset contains information about world's electricity generation from 1985. Data from BP. Follow datasource.kapsarc.org for timely data to advance energy economics research. Notes: Based on gross output. ♦ Less than 0.05% Excludes Slovenia prior to 1990. Notes: Annual changes and share of total are calculated using terawatt-hours figures. Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Electricity. The portal shows 2022-10-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
